name: redis
description: Redis: binary-safe strings, hashes, lists, sets, sorted sets, streams, SCAN and publish, with an optional key prefix (agent tools read-only unless REDIS_TOOL_ALLOW_WRITES=1)

nodes.description: Read a string value. Returns null when the key does not exist; values above REDIS_MAX_VALUE_BYTES come back cut, with `truncated: true`.

encoding.description: `utf8` (text; values that are not valid UTF-8 come back as {"base64": "…"}) or `base64` (binary)

outputs.description: API result

encoding.description: `utf8` (text; values that are not valid UTF-8 come back as {"base64": "…"}) or `base64` (binary)

tools.name: srem
tools.description: Remove members from a set. Returns how many were there. Agent tool calls need REDIS_TOOL_ALLOW_WRITES=1.

key.description: Key (REDIS_KEY_PREFIX is added in front); a binary key as {"base64": "…"}

encoding.description: `utf8` (text; values that are not valid UTF-8 come back as {"base64": "…"}) or `base64` (binary)

tools.name: zadd
tools.description: Add members with scores to a sorted set, e.g. [{"member": "budi", "score": 120}]. Returns how many were new (or changed, with `changed: true`). Agent tool calls need REDIS_TOOL_ALLOW_WRITES=1.

key.description: Key (REDIS_KEY_PREFIX is added in front); a binary key as {"base64": "…"}

condition.description: NX: only add new members; XX: only update existing ones

comparison.description: Only update when the new score is greater (GT) or less (LT)

changed.description: Count changed scores as well as new members

encoding.description: `utf8` (text; values that are not valid UTF-8 come back as {"base64": "…"}) or `base64` (binary)

tools.name: zrange
tools.description: Read sorted-set members by rank (`start`/`stop`) or, with `by_score`, by score (`min`/`max`, e.g. "(10" or "+inf"); lowest first unless `reverse`. At most 1000 members.

key.description: Key (REDIS_KEY_PREFIX is added in front); a binary key as {"base64": "…"}

start.description: First index (negative counts from the end)

stop.description: Last index, inclusive (-1 is the last item); at most 1000 items are returned

by_score.description: Select by score between `min` and `max` instead of by rank

with_scores.description: Return {member, score} items instead of members

encoding.description: `utf8` (text; values that are not valid UTF-8 come back as {"base64": "…"}) or `base64` (binary)

tools.name: zrem
tools.description: Remove members from a sorted set. Returns how many were there. Agent tool calls need REDIS_TOOL_ALLOW_WRITES=1.

key.description: Key (REDIS_KEY_PREFIX is added in front); a binary key as {"base64": "…"}

encoding.description: `utf8` (text; values that are not valid UTF-8 come back as {"base64": "…"}) or `base64` (binary)

tools.name: scan
tools.description: List keys in pages with SCAN (never KEYS): pass `match` (glob, e.g. "cart:*"), `count` as a hint and the returned next_cursor to continue. Keys are returned without REDIS_KEY_PREFIX.

match.description: Glob pattern within the prefix, e.g. "order:*"

count.description: How much work SCAN does per page (a hint; a page may hold more or fewer keys)

encoding.description: `utf8` (text; values that are not valid UTF-8 come back as {"base64": "…"}) or `base64` (binary)

tools.name: publish
tools.description: Publish a message on a pub/sub channel (REDIS_KEY_PREFIX is added to the channel). Returns how many subscribers received it. Agent tool calls need REDIS_TOOL_ALLOW_WRITES=1.

message.description: Message (text, or base64 with encoding: base64)

encoding.description: `utf8` (text; values that are not valid UTF-8 come back as {"base64": "…"}) or `base64` (binary)

tools.name: xadd
tools.description: Append an entry {field: value} to a stream, optionally trimming it to about `max_length` entries. Returns the new entry id. Agent tool calls need REDIS_TOOL_ALLOW_WRITES=1.

key.description: Key (REDIS_KEY_PREFIX is added in front); a binary key as {"base64": "…"}

max_length.description: Trim the stream to about this many entries (MAXLEN ~)

no_create.description: Do not create the stream when it does not exist

encoding.description: `utf8` (text; values that are not valid UTF-8 come back as {"base64": "…"}) or `base64` (binary)

tools.name: xrange
tools.description: Read stream entries between `start` and `end` ids ("-" and "+" for the ends), oldest first unless `reverse`. Pass next_cursor back as `start` (or `end` when reversed) for the next page.

key.description: Key (REDIS_KEY_PREFIX is added in front); a binary key as {"base64": "…"}

start.description: First id ("-" for the oldest; "(id" excludes it)

encoding.description: `utf8` (text; values that are not valid UTF-8 come back as {"base64": "…"}) or `base64` (binary)

tools.name: xreadgroup
tools.description: Read entries for a consumer of a consumer group (never blocks). `id` ">" gets new entries (and records them as pending for this consumer); "0" re-reads this consumer's pending entries. Counts as a write because it changes the group's state. Agent tool calls need REDIS_TOOL_ALLOW_WRITES=1.

key.description: Key (REDIS_KEY_PREFIX is added in front); a binary key as {"base64": "…"}

id.description: ">" for new entries, or an id to read pending entries after it

no_ack.description: Acknowledge the returned entries right away (no xack needed). Entries the size cap leaves out stay pending and are listed in `pending_ids`.

encoding.description: `utf8` (text; values that are not valid UTF-8 come back as {"base64": "…"}) or `base64` (binary)

tools.name: xgroup_create
tools.description: Create a consumer group on a stream, starting at `id` ("$" for only new entries, "0" for the whole stream). Creates the stream when missing unless `create_stream` is false. Agent tool calls need REDIS_TOOL_ALLOW_WRITES=1.

key.description: Key (REDIS_KEY_PREFIX is added in front); a binary key as {"base64": "…"}

id.description: "$" (new entries only), "0" (everything) or an entry id

create_stream.description: Create an empty stream when the key does not exist (MKSTREAM)

tools.name: xack
tools.description: Acknowledge entries a consumer group has processed, so they leave the pending list. Returns how many were pending. Agent tool calls need REDIS_TOOL_ALLOW_WRITES=1.

key.description: Key (REDIS_KEY_PREFIX is added in front); a binary key as {"base64": "…"}
